question: What is the primary benefit offered to businesses in Special Economic Zones (SEZs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tax and duty concessions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Special Economic Zones (SEZs)** are designated areas in countries that possess special economic regulations that differ from other areas in the same country.
 
• One of the primary benefits offered to businesses in SEZs is **tax and duty concessions**, which include exemptions or reductions in various taxes and duties such as income tax, sales tax, and customs duties.
